name: 乔瑟夫

idle.desc: standing, arms at sides (brown glove = left hand); f1 breath

walk.desc: walk cycle, arms swinging (contact, pass, contact, pass)

run.desc: run cycle, leaning forward, holding his hat on with the gloved hand

point.desc: smug wink, pointing: "your next line is..."

camera.desc: f0 camera raised high in gloved hand, other hand cocked; f1 Hermit Purple vines burst along the arm, karate chop smashes the camera

shock.desc: "OH MY GOD!": hands on head, mouth wide; f1 hat pops up, jolt

hurt.desc: hit recoil, leaning back, hat knocked up

lie.desc: lying on his back (60x20), head right, eyes closed, hat fallen beside; anchor = ground

portrait.desc: bust: wide-brim hat, grey beard; f0 closed, f1 talking

portrait_shock.desc: "OH MY GOD!": white eyes, huge open mouth, sweat; f1 mouth wider

expressions.desc: bust: wide-brim hat, grey beard; f0 closed, f1 talking
"OH MY GOD!": white eyes, huge open mouth, sweat; f1 mouth wider

source.call: game.art_later_existing / game.orig（import assets; assets.load_all(); from engine import sprite; sprite.get('joseph.<动作>').frames）；原引擎绘制：engine.sprite.draw(img, 'joseph.<动作>', x, y, frame=i, flip=False)

notes: 乔瑟夫（Joseph Joestar），主角团·人物。朝向：所有帧默认朝右；朝左请水平翻转（以 pivot 的 x 为轴，见 README）。锚点语义（各动作按自己的锚点对齐到 pivot）：脚点(底部中点)=idle/walk/run/float/point/camera/shock/hurt/lie/portrait/portrait_shock；脚点(自定义点)=dodge/guard/whip。idle：棕色手套 = 左手（义肢）。lie：仰卧，头朝右（与 avdol/kakyoin 的 down 方向相反），帽子掉在身旁；锚点=地面。portrait* 动作是说话头像（32×32 半身）：图集里放在最后几行（按底部中点对齐，只是为了同格对齐，不代表脚点），同时逐帧导出到“头像”文件夹，见 expressions；多数 frame0=闭嘴/静态、frame1=说话/加强（具体见各自 desc），原引擎对话框打字时以 8fps 来回切换。fps 取自源码 define(fps=…) 的建议播放速度（没给的用 6），场景里实际播放速率不统一；kind（loop/oneshot/static）是按帧描述和场景用法人工标注的。
